model: V7 single-leg PCA residual statistical arbitrage
finding: The post-multiplicity residual-z threshold is applied to the last historical training residual before the current executable-book residual is scored.

current_source_behavior.ordering: historical endpoint gate executes before current-book scoring

economic_interpretation: This does not establish positive PCA alpha or PnL.
It can admit a residual opportunity after the residual has already mean-reverted at the current book.
It can reject a currently extreme residual because the training endpoint was mild.
The candidate filter is therefore not aligned with the state used for current single-leg execution economics.
required_successor: Compute the current PCA score first and apply the residual-z floor to abs(score.residual_z).
Keep the historical endpoint z only as a diagnostic field.
Do not change target-excluded PCA, conditional target-residual I(1) bootstrap, BY multiplicity, total single-leg risk, TTR, authoritative fee, depth/slippage, or PAPER-only boundaries.
Re-run 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately on identical chronological data; do not pool horizons.
Require forward executable fills and positive fill-conditioned post-cost PnL before promotion.
